## ILmdbEnvOptions.encoding property

LMDB native value encoding — passed to `root.openDB()` and inherited by all sub-databases.

**Signature:**

```typescript
encoding?: ILmdbEncoding;
```

## Remarks

- `msgpack` (default) — fastest, supports `Date`<!-- -->/`Map`<!-- -->/`Set`<!-- -->/BigInt - `json` — human-readable; LMDB does `JSON.stringify`<!-- -->/`JSON.parse` natively - `binary` — values must be `Buffer`<!-- -->; LMDB stores raw bytes - `string` — values must be strings; LMDB stores as UTF-8 - `ordered-binary` — values encoded with the same encoding as keys

All sub-databases in this env share the same encoding.
